text:
The unemployment rate of 9.8% and headline CPI of -1.32% YoY point to late 2009. Headline CPI bottomed around -2.1% in July 2009 and was about -1.3% in October 2009. Unemployment was 10.0% in October 2009 and 9.8% in September 2009, so September or October fits.

Other cues: the 12m change in unemployment of +3.6 means a year earlier it was 6.2%, which matches September 2008 (6.1-6.2%). The VIX at 24.76 is consistent with September 2009 (about 25) or October 2009 (about 24.5). The 12m VIX change of -35 fits September 2009 against September 2008, when the VIX was around 40-46. For October 2009 against October 2008 it would be about -45 or lower. September 2009 CPI was -1.3% YoY, and October was -0.2%. Core CPI at 1.5% also fits September 2009.

Gold rose 4.7% in the month, consistent with September 2009. Payrolls averaged -256k over three months, which fits too.

The unemployment rate of 9.8% as published for September 2009 fits.
